## Load packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rprojroot)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(Seurat)
  library(patchwork)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(SeuratExtend)
})

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "downstream-analyses")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results", "tcell")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots", "tcell")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source trajectory helper functions
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "trajectory_helpers.R"))

# Analysis parameters
subtype_label <- "tcell"
```

## Load v2 tcell object
```{r load-data}
tcell_obj <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cart_tcell_subtypes_v2.rds"))

table(tcell_obj$tcell_subtype)
```

## Slingshot for Pseudotime Analysis
```{r prepare-slingshot-object}
traj_obj <- subset(
  tcell_obj,
  subset = !tcell_subtype %in% c(
    "Antigen-presenting myeloid cells",
    "NK-like cytotoxic lymphocytes"
  )
)
```

```{r run-slingshot}
traj_obj[["CCA20"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = Embeddings(traj_obj, "integrated.cca")[, 1:20, drop = FALSE],
  key = "CCA20_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(traj_obj)
)

traj_obj <- RunSlingshot(
  traj_obj, 
  group.by = "tcell_subtype", 
  reducedDim = "CCA20",
  start.clus = "Naïve / central-memory T cells")
```

```{r extract-slingshot-pseudotime}
sling <- traj_obj@misc$slingshot$CCA20$SlingPseudotime
head(sling)
```

```{r plot-slingshot-pseudotime}
traj_obj@meta.data[,colnames(sling)] <- as.data.frame(sling)

p_slingshot_pseudotime <- DimPlot2(
  traj_obj,
  reduction = "umap",
  features = colnames(sling),
  cols = "C",
  theme = NoAxes()
)

p_slingshot_pseudotime

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_pseudotime_umap.pdf"),
  plot = p_slingshot_pseudotime,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r build-slingshot-pseudotime-table}
sling_df <- as.data.frame(sling) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    traj_obj@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      dplyr::select(cell, tcell_subtype, seurat_clusters, condition),
    by = "cell"
  )
```

```{r summarize-slingshot-pseudotime}
sling_summary <- sling_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("slingPseudotime"),
    names_to = "lineage",
    values_to = "pseudotime"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage, tcell_subtype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median_pseudotime = median(pseudotime),
    mean_pseudotime = mean(pseudotime),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(lineage, median_pseudotime)

sling_summary
```

```{r save-slingshot-pseudotime-summary}
p_sling_summary <- ggplot(sling_summary, aes(x = median_pseudotime, y = reorder(tcell_subtype, median_pseudotime))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#2166AC") +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free_y") +
  xlab("Median Slingshot pseudotime") +
  ylab("T cell subtype") +
  labs(size = "Cells")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    plot_dir,
    "tcell_slingshot_pseudotime_all_lineages_summary.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_sling_summary,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

## Slingshot lineage curves on UMAP
```{r slingshot-lineage-curves-on-umap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sling_res <- traj_obj@misc$slingshot$CCA20

# Pseudotime matrix from Slingshot
sling <- sling_res$SlingPseudotime
pseudotime_cols <- colnames(sling)

# UMAP coordinates + metadata + pseudotime
umap_df <- Embeddings(traj_obj, "umap") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell")

colnames(umap_df)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

umap_df <- umap_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    traj_obj@meta.data %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      dplyr::select(
        cell,
        tcell_subtype,
        seurat_clusters,
        condition,
        dplyr::all_of(pseudotime_cols)
      ),
    by = "cell"
  )

# Make UMAP curves for all lineages
curve_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  paste0("Lineage ", seq_along(pseudotime_cols)),
  ~ make_umap_curve_from_pseudotime(
    umap_df = umap_df,
    lineage_col = .x,
    lineage_name = .y,
    approx_points = 150
  )
)

# Approximate lineage nodes as subtype centroids among cells assigned to each lineage
lineage_node_df <- make_lineage_node_df(umap_df, pseudotime_cols, min_cells = 10)

# Endpoint labels for overview plot
lineage_endpoint_df <- curve_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Overview plot
p_slingshot_overview <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = tcell_subtype),
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, group = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = lineage_node_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = lineage_endpoint_df,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, label = lineage),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(color = "T cell subtype") +
  ggtitle("Slingshot lineage curves on UMAP")

p_slingshot_overview

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_lineage_curves_overview_umap.pdf"),
  plot = p_slingshot_overview,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

# One plot per lineage
lineage_plots <- lapply(
  seq_along(pseudotime_cols),
  plot_one_sling_lineage,
  pseudotime_cols = pseudotime_cols,
  umap_df = umap_df,
  curve_df = curve_df,
  lineage_node_df = lineage_node_df
)

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_lineage_curves_each_lineage_umap.pdf"),
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  onefile = TRUE,
  family = "sans"
)

for (p in lineage_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

# Show first lineage in notebook
lineage_plots[[1]]
```

## Fast pseudotime differential expression screen
```{r fast-spearman-pseudotime-gene-screen}
genes_to_test <- VariableFeatures(traj_obj)

pseudotime_gene_screen <- purrr::map_dfr(
  pseudotime_cols,
  ~ fast_spearman_pseudotime_test(
    seu = traj_obj,
    pseudotime_col = .x,
    features = genes_to_test,
    min_detected_frac = 0.02
  )
)

utils::write.csv(
  pseudotime_gene_screen,
  file.path(results_dir, "tcell_slingshot_fast_spearman_pseudotime_gene_screen.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

top_pseudotime_genes <- pseudotime_gene_screen %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_adj)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = p_adj, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_pseudotime_genes
```

## Gene trend curves and heatmaps
```{r gene-trend-curves-and-heatmaps, fig.height=10, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gene_trend_curve_plots <- list()
gene_trend_heatmap_plots <- list()

for (lineage_name in pseudotime_cols) {
  
  top_genes <- get_top_pseudotime_genes(
    pseudotime_gene_screen,
    lineage_name,
    n = 40
  )
  
  if (length(top_genes) == 0) {
    next
  }
  
  top_curve_genes <- head(top_genes, 12)
  lineage_pseudotime <- as.data.frame(sling[, lineage_name, drop = FALSE])
  
  p_curve <- GeneTrendCurve.Slingshot(
    traj_obj,
    features = top_curve_genes,
    pseudotime.data = lineage_pseudotime,
    method = "smooth",
    point = FALSE,
    se = FALSE,
    ncol = 4
  )
  
  print(p_curve)
  gene_trend_curve_plots[[lineage_name]] <- p_curve
  
  p_heat <- GeneTrendHeatmap.Slingshot(
    traj_obj,
    features = top_genes,
    pseudotime.data = "CCA20",
    lineage = lineage_name,
    scale = TRUE,
    sort = TRUE
  )
  
  print(p_heat)
  gene_trend_heatmap_plots[[lineage_name]] <- p_heat
}

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_gene_trend_curves_all_lineages.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  onefile = TRUE,
  family = "sans"
)

for (p in gene_trend_curve_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "tcell_slingshot_gene_trend_heatmaps_all_lineages.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  onefile = TRUE,
  family = "sans"
)

for (p in gene_trend_heatmap_plots) {
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```
